englishDefinition: a round fruit with red, green or yellow skin

examples.en: I eat an apple every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上吃一个苹果。

examples.en: This apple is very sweet.

englishDefinition: the clear liquid that falls as rain and is used for drinking

examples.en: Please give me a glass of water.
We should drink enough water every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天应该喝足够的水。

englishDefinition: a person who teaches in a school

examples.en: Our English teacher is very kind.
examples.zh: 我们的英语老师很和蔼。

examples.en: She wants to become a teacher.

englishDefinition: a place where children go to learn

examples.en: My brother goes to school by bus.
The school is near my home.

englishDefinition: the color of grass and leaves

examples.en: The trees are green in spring.
She likes the green dress.

englishDefinition: the early part of the day

examples.en: I get up at six in the morning.
Good morning, everyone!

englishDefinition: to move through water by moving your body

examples.en: I can swim very well.
They swim in the pool every Saturday.
examples.zh: 他们每周六在游泳池游泳。

englishDefinition: a group of people who live together

examples.en: There are five people in my family.
I love my family.
The children look very happy.
I am happy to see you.

englishDefinition: to move very quickly on foot

examples.en: He runs in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上在公园跑步。

examples.en: Don’t run in the classroom.
